text:
jules: Quick thought: route decision could see a lightweight 'hotness' signal from the serving plane to bias toward nodes with model KV cached. Could save p50 and cross-region egress.

amir: Is this boolean or graded? Also must never violate tenant region pins or residency.

jules: Graded: local_kv_hotness 0-100, advisory only.

tara: Two concerns: telemetry cardinality and policy compiler semantics.

amir: Sidecar plan: aggregate rolling hit_rate and avg_kv_ms and publish per-(model,region,instance_class) every 60s. Optional tenant masks for top-N tenants.

ops-bot: Any new route attribute must be behind a feature flag and follow canary checklist. Suggest ENABLE_LOCAL_CACHE_HINTS.

rick: Combine hotness with route load: score = base - alpha*load + beta*hotness, beta small. Add dampening to avoid oscillation.

tara: Include sample_ts and estimated_ttl_ms so policy decays score near expiry to avoid stale data.

jules: Proto suggestion: an optional compact field local_kv_hint {hotness, sample_ts, ttl_ms, agg_key}. Compiler must forbid using it for hard affinity. Add lint to block equality checks.

amir: Sidecar should fail-open; if missing, routing unchanged. Keep retention of this telemetry short (1h).

rick: Testing: simulation harness with synthetic hotness/load traces to tune alpha/beta and dampening. Unit tests to ensure pinned-region policies ignore hotness.

tara: Rollout: enable flag, small-region canary, monitor p50/p95, cross-region egress, routing churn, and decision_reason logs. Keep decision traces for 7 days for tuning.

jules: Action items: jules -> RFC draft + proto; amir -> sidecar PR + aggregation knobs; tara -> compiler lint + examples; rick -> sim harness + decay curves. ops-bot: add canary checklist to ops runbook.

ops-bot: Reminder: update policy changelog and schedule 2x canaries before global.
